Container.Name: SD-WebUI-Forge-Neo-Unraid
Container.Description:
Forge Neo (Stable Diffusion WebUI) by Haoming02, packaged for Unraid by Aegisnir, with security hardening. Forge Neo is Haoming02's work: https://github.com/Haoming02/sd-webui-forge-classic/tree/neo This container only packages it for Unraid. Please report WebUI bugs upstream.
Image: ghcr.io/aegisnir/sd-webui-forge-neo-unraid:dev
README: https://github.com/aegisnir/sd-webui-forge-neo-unraid/blob/dev/README.md
## Security Hardening Defaults The template sets the following security options by default: - --read-only: Makes the container filesystem read-only except for explicitly mounted paths (like /data). - --tmpfs /tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,nodev,size=2g: Provides a safe, writable /tmp. - --security-opt no-new-privileges:true: Prevents processes from gaining new privileges. - --cap-drop=ALL --cap-add=CHOWN --cap-add=FOWNER --cap-add=SETUID --cap-add=SETGID: Uses a least-privilege capability set needed for startup self-heal and privilege drop. - --pids-limit=2048: A practical default to contain runaway process spawning without being overly restrictive.
To change PID limit in Unraid: edit this container, switch to advanced view, adjust --pids-limit=<value> in Extra Parameters, and apply.
DATA DIRECTORY WARNING: The path used with --data-dir grows very large very quickly because it can hold models, outputs, extensions, caches, and other working data. I recommend storing it outside of appdata when possible. You can still place it inside appdata if you want the convenience, but it may consume space very quickly and can fill the location you use for Docker-related storage.
The default host path is set to /mnt/user/ai/data/ so the large working set lives outside appdata by default.
Self-healing data directory: The container automatically corrects /data ownership on startup if it is owned by another user (for example, after deleting the host data path, or data copied from another container). In most cases no user action is needed. A log message will confirm when ownership was corrected. If the auto-fix fails (NFS root squash, unusual host permissions), the log will explain the manual fix.
Authentication defaults: This container uses auth-file based login by default. On first launch, startup seeds /config/auth/webui-auth.txt if missing. Default end-user login (first launch): admin / changeme Startup does not block this default; change it after first login for normal use. Use WEBUI_AUTH_FILE to override the auth-file path if needed. Recommended auth file path: /config/auth/webui-auth.txt Example syntax: - one per line: admin:strong-password - or comma-separated: admin:strong-password,viewer:another-password - lines starting with # are ignored as comments
Model checkpoint note: Forge Neo never downloads a model on its own. Add a .safetensors file under /data/models/Stable-diffusion.
Log safety: Sensitive auth flags (--gradio-auth, --gradio-auth-path, --api-auth) have their values replaced with <redacted> in startup log output, so logs are safe to share.
Built-in healthcheck: The image includes a Docker HEALTHCHECK that probes port 7860. It uses generous timers (5 min start grace, 5 retries) to avoid false positives during model loading or heavy extension operations. Unhealthy status is informational only and does not auto-restart the container.
Container.Overview:
Image: ghcr.io/aegisnir/sd-webui-forge-neo-unraid:dev The default Extra Parameters include --runtime=nvidia so Docker can expose the NVIDIA runtime inside the container. Full setup and usage docs: https://github.com/aegisnir/sd-webui-forge-neo-unraid/blob/dev/README.md
This template passes Forge Neo data storage through --data-dir.
- Models, outputs, extensions, caches, and other working data are stored in the mapped data share instead of the container filesystem. - Python, PyTorch and all WebUI dependencies are built into the image, so startup needs no downloads (extensions may still install their own packages). - The data directory can grow very large very quickly, so I recommend storing it outside of appdata when possible. - If startup fails with a Torch GPU check error, you can temporarily add --skip-torch-cuda-test to COMMANDLINE_ARGS for troubleshooting. - If an extension breaks torch, delete /data/python-user on the host and restart. It holds only packages installed by extensions. - WebUI login is enabled by default unless you explicitly set your own --gradio-auth or --gradio-auth-path in COMMANDLINE_ARGS. - Container logs annotate known harmless warnings inline and display a [READY] box when the WebUI is accepting connections. - A built-in Docker healthcheck monitors port 7860 with conservative timers to avoid false positives during heavy operations.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: Port exposed by the Forge Neo WebUI (default: 7860).

Config.Name: Config Directory
Config.Description: Host path for auth files and WebUI settings (appdata). Kept separate from the large AI data share so it can be backed up with standard Unraid appdata backup tools. Default: /mnt/user/appdata/SD-WebUI-Forge-Neo-Unraid

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: Host path mapped to --data-dir. Default: /mnt/user/ai/data/ (outside appdata).

Config.Name: WebUI Auth File
Config.Description: Path inside the container to the WebUI auth file (recommended/default: /config/auth/webui-auth.txt). If the file is missing on first launch, startup seeds it from the repository default template. Default seeded login is admin:changeme. Format: username:password per line, or comma-separated entries on one line. Blank lines and # comments are ignored. For security, change the default password after first login.

Config.Name: HTTPS
Config.Description: auto (default): serve HTTPS. Uses /config/tls/custom.crt and custom.key if you provide both, otherwise a self-signed certificate created in /config/tls (your browser warns once; compare the SHA-256 fingerprint printed in the log). off: plain HTTP.

Config.Name: HTTPS Hostnames
Config.Description: Optional. Comma-separated hostnames or IPv4 addresses you open the WebUI with, for example tower.local,192.168.1.10. They are added to the self-signed certificate so the browser's address matches it.

Config.Name: API Auth File Mode
Config.Description: Controls API authentication when WEBUI_AUTH_FILE is set and API is enabled via --api. 'mirror-webui-file' mirrors the auth file into --api-auth. 'disabled' (default) leaves API auth unset unless you pass your own --api-auth in COMMANDLINE_ARGS.

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: Optional file creation mask (octal), for example 0027. Leave empty to keep the container default behavior and easier host-side access.

Config.Name: Extra Args
Config.Description: Extra arguments for launch.py. Default: --listen --port 7860 --data-dir /data. Forge Neo stops on unknown flags, so check its README before adding any. To manage extensions from the WebUI, add --enable-insecure-extension-access (anyone who can log in can then run code in the container). API is disabled by default; add --api only if you explicitly need it. No attention package is installed: Neo uses PyTorch's built-in attention. Adding --xformers or --sage installs that package into /data/python-user on next start. For GPU errors, try adding --skip-torch-cuda-test temporarily.
